build_domain_randomize: build a domain randomization function that randomizes robot dynamics parameters for the T1 environment
randomize_floor_friction: randomize floor geom friction within U(0.2, 0.6) for the T1 robot environment
randomize_joint_parameters: randomize joint frictionloss, armature, stiffness, and damping parameters for the T1 robot
randomize_body_masses: randomize all link body masses by U(0.98, 1.02) and add torso mass perturbation of U(-1.0, 1.0)
randomize_initial_positions: randomize initial joint positions qpos0 with uniform jitter of U(-0.05, 0.05) for the T1 robot
